summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democrats to win control of the Senate rose sharply today. The projected seat count moved to 55-45, up from 54-46, which would mean Democrats gain control, and [[Mississippi]] is a newly predicted flip. The market also saw a sharp rise in the chances of the Democrat Annie Andrews in [[South Carolina]], another predicted flip, and of the Democrat Scott Colom in Mississippi.
summaries.governor: Polymarket odds for [[Texas]] moved sharply toward the Democrat Gina Hinojosa, and the market now shows a predicted flip there. [[Nevada]] saw a similar sharp move, with the Democrat Aaron Ford gaining ground and also marked as a predicted flip. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Cindy Holscher also gained ground sharply.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the House rose by a sizable amount, and the market continues to favour the Democrats. The market's projected seat count recently changed to 256-177-1, down from 257-176-1, which still means Democrats gain control, and [[NC-03 (Greenville & Jacksonville)]] is a newly predicted flip.
